West Virginia — threshold is 25,000 (John's exception), and there are no close calls at that line: Wheeling (27,052) is the smallest place in, and the next place down, Martinsburg (18,777), misses by more than 6,000. Only Charleston and Huntington clear 40,000
source: 2020 Census (U.S. Census Bureau) — official population counts as of April 1, 2020. Compiled from Wikipedia's per-state municipality/CDP lists (2020 Census columns), the Census Bureau's TIGERweb 2020 place files, the Georgia Legislative Reapportionment Office's 2020 Census city compilation, and Census QuickFacts; every place in the 38,000-42,000 band was cross-checked against a second Census Bureau source.
